verdict.rationale: Gitea is self-hosted and uses standard Git repos, so code itself is inherently portable, and docs mention migrating repos in/out (e.g., from Gogs) plus an API for building custom export workflows. However, there is no documented full 'export all data' feature, and community reports explicitly describe migration and backup/restore as difficult or lacking (gitea-comm-15, gitea-comm-19), undercutting a clean 'leave with all your data' story. Missing for 10: a documented comprehensive data-export/backup mechanism covering issues, wiki, and metadata in open formats, and evidence this works smoothly in practice.
